messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered — CDN POP us-central1-pop-03 reporting sustained packet loss (20-40%) to upstream last-mile. Observed elevated 5xx rates and tail latency. Severity: sev2. Runbook: https://internal/runbooks/cdn-pop-packetloss :rotating_light:
Maya: taking pager, oncall. starting triage now. I see alerts from synthetic probes and portal spikes in 5xx for that POP.
Maya: quick facts: POP id=us-central1-pop-03, provider=FastEdge, affected AZ~us-central1-b. Traffic fraction ~15% but error rate concentrated there (5xx ~= 8x baseline).
Maya: traceroute from our probe -> 198.51.100.45 (edge ej-01):
```
traceroute to 198.51.100.45 (198.51.100.45), 30 hops max
 1  10.0.0.1 (10.0.0.1)  0.42 ms  0.36 ms  0.34 ms
 2  203.0.113.5 (203.0.113.5)  1.20 ms  1.18 ms  1.15 ms
 3  * * *
 4  * * *
 5  198.51.100.1 (198.51.100.1)  35.6 ms  36.1 ms  35.9 ms
```
Maya: seeing consistent timeouts at hop 3-4, then intermittent reachability. looks like last-mile packet loss / blackholing.
Kevin: Kevin (neteng) jumping in. I'll check BGP sessions and provider NOC. Any short-lived flaps in our routers?
Maya: control-plane looks stable; BGP sessions ok from our side, but AS path shows intermittent withdraws from provider side.
Kevin: ping/flows show 25-30% loss towards their next-hop. opening provider ticket now.
Kevin: provider contact (Vendor-FastEdge) — can you confirm if there are known last-mile issues to us-central1-b?
Vendor-FastEdge: FastEdge NOC: we see packet loss on a downstream peering port feeding customers in us-central1-b. Investigating, possible transport harvest. Ticket FE-98723 opened.
Maya: thanks. we should plan mitigation: reroute impacted traffic to fallback POP us-east1-pop-02 for critical customer segments. DNS TTL for pop hostname is 60s but CDN origin mapping and caches may honor mapping for up to 5m.
Kevin: I can push temporary path prepends and adjust route weights at the edge LB. prepping AS-path prepend + traffic shift playbook.
Maya: executing partial weight shift (critical tags only) now to avoid all-in failover. holding non-critical at 15% to monitor error/backpressure.
ops-bot: deployment-hold set on configs touching CDN mapping (auto-lock engaged).
Mike: Mike (support) here — creating initial customer incident note. most impacted customers flagged: AcmeCorp, PennyBank, Searchly. I'll queue update for the customer list and support pages.
Maya: provider FE-98723 status: acknowledging, NOC escalated to transport team, ETA ~25m for initial fix/route reconverge. I'll keep watching metrics and traces.
Maya: handoff — I'm handing active mitigation & network ops to Kevin (Kevin now owns routing changes and provider comms). I'll stay on comms for customer updates. Handoff time ~1819008920. :rotating_light:
Kevin: taking it. I'll confirm when route prepends and weight changes are in effect and post confirmation. :white_check_mark:
Mike: I'll send initial customer advisory saying we're mitigating by rehoming traffic and vendor is investigating; ETA for full recovery TBD.
Maya: thanks team. keep all updates here. escalate to oncall L2 network if we don't see improvement in 30m. :thumbsup:
